title: Enumeration of skew morphisms of cyclic $2$-groups
summary: A skew morphism of a finite group $B$ is a permutation of $B$ fixing the identity and satisfying $\varphi(xy) = \varphi(x)\varphi^{i_x}(y)$ for some integers $i_x$ indexed by $x \in B$. The enumeration of skew morphisms of finite cyclic groups remains an open problem. The most substantial progress to date concerns cyclic $p$-groups with $p$ odd, for which a full classification and enumeration was obtained by Kovács and Nedela. In this paper we treat the remaining case $p = 2$, giving a complete classification and enumeration of skew morphisms of finite cyclic $2$-groups. Writing…
